activity.detail:
I opened one pull request: a fix to how the talk renderer reads HTML entities (codes like &).

- The bug: decode() in scripts/render/parse.mjs didn't reject made-up entity names that happen to match a built-in JavaScript object property, like &constructor; or &toString;. Instead of failing as an unknown entity, the renderer wrote JavaScript source text (function Object() { [native code] }) into the talk.
- The fix: the lookup now accepts only the entities actually listed, so those names fail with "unknown entity".
- The test: a new test in src/render.test.ts fails without the fix and passes with it.
- Checks: Predictable Code's fix-check says the defect is gone and nothing new appeared. The typecheck is clean.
- Pull request: branch fix-render-entity-lookup, onto main. You had no other open pull requests from me, so it can't conflict with any.

The push itself needs nothing more. Its MCP docs (mcp/README.md, the server instructions) already describe list-templates. The metadata build passes with --strict and the 28 MCP tests pass. Only .predictable-code/ holds spec files, none tracked in git, so there were none to update.
